sample_unit: patients (159 multicenter CSC triage cohort + 226 single-center consecutive cohort)
models_evaluated: Custom 3-step deep-learning pipeline (midline correction, ischemic core segmentation, HAS segmentation)

links.outcome: Reader HAS-detection performance (JAFROC FOM) with versus without model assistance in crossover multi-reader study
links.effect: Model assistance significantly improved HAS-detection performance, increasing JAFROC Figure of Merit from 0.71 to 0.77 (p < 0.01), among 10 specialists and residents.
links.quote: In the reader study, model assistance significantly improved HAS-detection performance, increasing JAFROC Figure of Merit from 0.71 to 0.77 (p < 0.01).

links.outcome: Performance across two validation settings (multicenter CSC cohort vs single-center consecutive cohort)
links.effect: PPV was 92.0% (80/87) in the CSC triage cohort but 44.1% (26/59) in the all-comer cohort; sensitivity was similar (76.2% vs 74.3%), specificity 87.0% vs 82.7%.
links.quote: In Part 1B, the model achieved a sensitivity of 74.3% (26/35), specificity of 82.7% (158/191), PPV of 44.1% (26/59), NPV of 94.6% (158/167), and accuracy of 81.4% (184/226), reflecting preserved discrimination in a lower-prevalence, broader real-world population.
